title: Nonlinear parabolic thin sets and parabolic Wolff inequalities
summary: We prove a parabolic analogue of Wolff's inequality adapted to the intrinsic scaling $δ_c(x,t)=(cx,c^2t)$ and formulated in terms of time-backward parabolic dyadic rectangles. As a consequence, we obtain equivalent characterizations of parabolic $(α,q)$-thinness in this geometric setting and establish the associated Kellogg and Choquet properties.
